title: Choose the visual world for WorkBridge
question: The roll assigned Air Operations Control. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Air Operations Control
options.lineage: airport operations centers and Solari departure boards
options.thesis: The app as a departure board: every assignment, timesheet, and invoice has a status, and status is what you see first.
materials: Solari amber as sole warm accent
options.viewport: Dark shell. Left nav rail with WorkBridge wordmark. Top strip: four large-type counter units (Contracts · On Assignment · Pending Approvals · Outstanding Invoices). Below: a scrollable status board of active contracts — dense rows, amber status pills in condensed tracked caps, employee count badges, no decorative chrome.
options.risk: Reads generic dark-dashboard if the amber flip-transition on status change is not committed.

raised.raise: All numbers and IDs in tabular monospace; column alignment as tight as a split-flap flight board.
Dashboard header counters are large-type display units — not small KPI chips.
One amber accent runs the entire UI; the only warm tone on a cool near-black ground.
Section separators use deep void negative space, not hairline dividers.
Status pills: condensed tracked uppercase, gridded tight to the edge — no soft rounded badges.

options.label: Bloomberg Dark
options.lineage: financial data terminals and professional trading dashboards
options.thesis: Every screen is a data terminal: dense tables, status columns, no chrome that is not data.
options.viewport: Near-black ground. Top: compact identity bar with active user. Left: narrow nav column. Main: a dense paginated table of the primary entity. Status shown as colored code glyphs, not prose words. No cards, no decoration.
options.risk: This is where most professional dark-dashboard runs land. Familiar and effective — never distinctive.

options.label: Parametric Identity
options.lineage: generative brand identities and seed-derived design systems
options.thesis: The WorkBridge mark reseeds from live operational data; the palette shifts as the contract portfolio shifts.
options.viewport: Dark-navy shell. Parametric mark top-left redraws on each session. Left nav. Main: tabular list with one accent color that updates when the data seed changes.
options.case: Holds product clarity — parametric data can enhance scanning. Loses narrowly on audience identification for a strictly B2B ops context.
options.risk: Parametric animation adds perceived complexity to an Operate-mode tool.

options.label: Datafield Barcode
options.case: Binary B/W removes the color-coded status that approval workflows require.
options.kept: Extreme monospace tabular discipline and column-density doctrine.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.lineage: nixie tube laboratory counters and instrument panels
options.case: Nixie form excels at individual metrics but cannot carry the dense list and table operations the product requires.
options.kept: Key metrics as large display-counter units rather than small KPI chips.

options.label: TDR Info-Noise
options.lineage: The Designers Republic sleeve graphic language
options.case: Rave/Wipeout aesthetic does not land on audience identification for B2B ops managers.
options.kept: Condensed tracked-caps status pills gridded tight to edge.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.lineage: silk fashion cape with drawcord transformation channels
options.case: Fashion transformation metaphor has no mapping to timesheet approval or invoice workflows.
options.kept: One gold accent thread against matte dark ground as the only warm color.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.case: Surreal impossible architecture provides no audience identification or task clarity for B2B operations.
options.kept: Deep void negative space as section separator doctrine.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean light sidebar dashboard with blue accent — at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: White shell, sidebar nav with blue active states, summary stat cards, data tables in main area.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other B2B SaaS dashboard.
